overall_reason: A slate-blue family holds the scene: a pale blue-grey ground #e3ecf2, chart bars stepped from #b8cbd8 to #597d96 for the current month, cool ink #33414a, and one muted green #527764 for the received payment.

score.reason: T-COLOUR-SOURCE and T-PALETTE-ROLES pass with one hue family and green held to success; T-NEUTRALS finds cool greys on a warm window body, and T-SURFACE-LADDER finds a second shadow recipe on the phone.

findings.title: Neutrals hold one temperature
findings.evidence: The window body is warm #f5f5f4, while the text greys are cool: #33414a on 7 elements and #83909a on 5 (17 cool counts in the neutral temperature table). The scene ground #e3ecf2 is also cool.
findings.before: Cool slate text on a warm off-white panel inside a cool scene.
findings.after: A body tint taken from the same slate hue as the ground and the ink.
findings.why: The warm panel is the one neutral that does not belong to the slate family.

findings.title: Depth comes from lightness and one shadow
findings.evidence: The palette table lists 2 shadow recipes: the window's rgba(24,52,59,0.22) 0 16px and the phone's rgba(50,50,93,0.25) 0 21px 43px -9px, which it counts as 1 heavy shadow.
findings.before: Two shadow recipes with different tints for two floating objects.
findings.after: One shadow recipe tinted from the ink, applied to both objects.
findings.why: Two recipes make the scene's depth inconsistent.

strengths: The chart uses lightness steps of one hue, with the darkest bar #597d96 marking the current month.
Green #527764 appears only on the 'Payment received' marks.
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page renders light; the stylesheet has a dark class theme that the capture did not render, so dark mode is not verified
brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours were available for T-COLOUR-SOURCE; sources were traced from the composition itself
contrast and focus: owned by the sweep (A11-001, A11-003) and not restated here
The phone's black bezel (#0b0b0c) and status bar are device chrome, not palette, and were left out of the text levels
The caption above the scene (#666666) is the capture's framing and was left out of the text levels
